        # Iterate through the remaining indices

def count_ways_to_express_n(n, x):
    # Initialize the result
    result = 0
    
    # Iterate over all possible values of x
    for i in range(1, x + 1):
        # Calculate the number of ways to express n as the sum of the i^th power of unique positive integers
        ways = (n // i) % (i - 1)
        
        # Add the number of ways to the result
        result += ways
